RMSSE_definition: sqrt(test log MSE / training mean squared daily (lag-1) target difference); fixed first-fold training scales with 21-observation purge; mean of six factor-specific RMSSEs
naive_definition: at t use completed t-h+1..t block to forecast t+1..t+h; identical evaluation origins to B/C/D/CV
scope: Historical chronological OOS, reused 2010-2024; descriptive RMSSE comparisons, no significance or economic endpoint claims
forecast_figure: All six factors, h=20, fixed calendar year 2013; no interval estimates
